venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR came in -10.6% vs target on Friday ($19,352.87 net vs $21,646.19).** (Segments: DC/AM $1,001.08 + D&C PM $18,351.79 + Garden/6A $6,068.46; food $2,837.10.) Comps $476.76 (2.46%). 353 guests (Tock) / $54.82 GCA. **Everyone was on deck for a big Friday** - the Pride Party in the Garden was once again a hit, and floor service captured all reservations and walk-ins even without use of the rail. AM was smooth with one IRD and a small cocktail pop (cold brew finished; kombucha in - blackberry sage and strawberry basil). A proud night: support staff watched Maggie & Willie work positions they hadn't in a while and crush it. Breaks complete; no no-shows; no incident. MOD: Maggie (AM Josh) / Carey & Lucas (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: **MG came in -0.9% vs target on Friday ($11,895 vs $12,000) - essentially on target.** Segments: Municipal Bar AM $1,578, PM $7,864, Sun Club $0, Hot Eye $2,330. Food $3,973. Comps $158. 297 Municipal Bar guests (64 AM / 233 PM) / $40.05 GCA. **Rain shaped the day** - an almost dead morning until a noon rainstorm drove people in to hide from the weather (1-2pm was the biggest hour at $600), kept slim on staffing. A quiet happy hour gave way to a surprising volume of walk-ins (possibly a Juneteenth bump as other businesses closed on a Friday); the floor was nearly fully seated 7-9pm and the bar stayed full past closing with a few bigger groups. Sun Club closed all day on scattered storms. Hot Eye had a nice pre-dinner start, a brief lull, then got busy when Brother Vinyl's DJ set started early - great pacing and vibes all night. Kitchen: low on peppers, 86 romanesco, crudo 86'd for an hour before a late delivery; light crostini sales on a busy floor. A birthday group treated to a free Mind Eraser downstairs loved everything. No incident. MOD: Sam / Lex & Shannon (AM) / Justin & Marcus/Drew (PM). Entered by Sam B.
